#!/bin/bash
# 10M of wiki-dpr grown by inserts with 8 callers and the series of the insert
# steps on m2 (bench-report.md of feat/posting-edge-index, "10M crecido por
# inserts, con la serie", 2026-11-27): the harness of the night of the 26th
# (TestNightGrow), with the marker of the timed session and the usual wait for
# an idle machine. Grow, then the heap of what it left in another process,
# then the power log. Run under caffeinate -i -s. The binary is built before,
# once ($G/grow.test); nothing here builds. The index stays: the 20 000
# inserts of the tables by doc id go over clones of it.
set -u
S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad
G=$S/grow10m
B=$G/grow.test
D=$HOME/Documents/datasets/wikidpr-10m-e5-inplace.bin

printf '10M of wiki-dpr grown by inserts with 8 callers (grow10m/grow.sh), timed, since %s for about eight hours; taken down by the experiments session\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" > $S/timed-session.lock

# The usual wait: the keyboard and the trackpad idle for 15 minutes.
hid_idle() { ioreg -c IOHIDSystem | awk '/HIDIdleTime/ {print int($NF/1000000000); exit}'; }
date "+== %H:%M:%S waiting for 900 s of idle (now $(hid_idle) s)"
while [ "$(hid_idle)" -lt 900 ]; do sleep 30; done
date "+== %H:%M:%S idle for $(hid_idle) s"

cd $G/src/adapters/repos/db/vector/postingedge || exit 2
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S grow" | tee $G/start.txt
PE_DATASET=$D PE_DIR=$G/index PE_OUT=$G/grow.json PE_CALLERS=8 PE_STRETCH=300 PE_MINFREE=4 \
  $B -test.run '^TestNightGrow$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $G/grow.log 2>&1
echo "grow exit $?"
date "+== %H:%M:%S heap routing"
PE_DIR=$G/index PE_CACHE=routing PE_HEAP=$G/heap-routing.heap PE_OUT=$G/heap-routing.json \
  $B -test.run '^TestNightHeap$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 -test.memprofilerate=1 > $G/heap-routing.log 2>&1
echo "heap exit $?"
go tool pprof -raw $B $G/heap-routing.heap 2>/dev/null > $G/heap-routing.raw
echo "raw exit $?"
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S done" | tee $G/end.txt
pmset -g log > $G/pmset.log 2>&1
echo "pmset exit $?"
rm -f /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/timed-session.lock
